method: Salaries from the Basketball-Reference contracts table, one polite fetch, cached raw under data/raw/salaries/. Matched by folded name plus team; salaries are never invented, unmatched players are null. Team payrolls in team_payrolls are BBRef team totals (every contract row for the team, including players who have not played yet); team_payrolls_matched sums only the players in our box-score data and understates the real payroll. Display only: salaries do not change any rating or TradeScore in v1.
